goal: Use one arm to steady the pen holder and the other arm to drop all four pens (two pens and two oil pens) into it, pen tip down, then leave the holder upright on the table and return the arms home.
instruction_templates: Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.
success: For each pen target0, target1 (category pen) and target2, target3 (category oil_pen): at least one of the pen's passive functional points tagged 'check' has horizontal distance < 0.035 m from the pen_holder's root origin, with the offset measured in the pen_holder's own frame (axis='object': delta rotated by the inverse of the holder's rotation, then xy norm). I.e. the pen's 'check' point must be within 3.5 cm of the holder's vertical axis.
For each pen: (top z of pen_holder's world bbox) - (bottom z of the pen's world bbox) > 0.035 m, i.e. the pen's lowest point must be more than 3.5 cm below the holder's rim/top.

For each pen: its 'check' passive functional point is at or below the pen's root origin in world z (point_z <= root_z + 1e-6, z_margin 0), i.e. the pen is inserted with the check end pointing down (not lying or upside down).
The pen_holder stands upright: its local +z axis within 15 degrees of world +z (is_axis_up default threshold=15).
All target robots back at start end-effector pose: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m and rotation <= 20 degrees (all_robot_back_to_origin defaults).
evaluation: Checked after every action; all conditions (four pens in, holder upright within 15 degrees, arm(s) home) must hold at the same step; the first such step is success. Fails at step_lim=1100 actions. No early-fail rule. 'Hold the pen holder with one hand' and 'put it back down' are not explicitly checked, only the end configuration (holder upright within 15 degrees). Process score (partial only): 10/25/40/90 for 1-4 pens satisfied (xy within 0.035, check point lower than root, check axis (local z of the 'check' point frame) within 45 degrees of world z, depth > 0.035) with the holder within 45 degrees of upright and grippers open (>= 0.8).
objects: target0, target1: pens (category pen, index in {0,1,4}, 2, duplicates allowed), lying on the table in the 'side_unit' pose, x in [-0.35,-0.04], y in [-0.20,0.10], random yaw in [0,120] degrees, margin 0.01 m.
target2, target3: oil pens (category oil_pen), 2, lying on the table ('side_unit'), same region x in [-0.35,-0.04], y in [-0.20,0.10], yaw in [0,120] degrees.
pen_holder: pen holder (category pen_holder), 1, on the table, x in [0.0,0.35], y in [-0.20,0.10], random yaw within +/-45 degrees. It is a rigid object that can be knocked over.
end_requirements: Target arms back within 0.15 m per axis and 20 degrees of start end-effector pose at the moment of success, with the holder upright within 15 degrees.
notes: The holder can tip or be dragged around: it must be standing within 15 degrees of upright when success is checked. Holder-pen xy distance is measured in the holder frame from the holder's root origin (not rim centre), so the holder's root must be near its axis (assumed). The 'check' point is an asset functional point (probably the pen tip end); its exact meaning is metadata and not determinable statically. Pens are accepted in any order and any slot. The holding-with-one-hand requirement is a suggestion; it is not enforced, but a freely sliding holder is hard to fill.
